title: Goldman Sachs says traders have Fed outlook wrong as oil surge drives rate-hike fears
summary: Goldman Sachs warns of market misreading of Federal Reserve's response to oil-driven inflation, with investors betting on higher U.S. interest rates amid surging energy prices and stagflation fears. President Trump hints at an end to the Iran war, potentially impacting crude prices and market stability.
sentiment_reason: The market is reacting to the combination of surging energy prices, inflation concerns, and geopolitical tensions, leading to negative sentiment due to fears of a potential recession and rate hikes.
